tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// bsnyen sgrub las zla seng lugs kyi dkar chag bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// phag mo'i byin rlabs ma dros mtshor// rgyud 'bras man ngag rin chen du// bsgyur ba'i dpal de ye ji bzhin// gzigs la mig mi 'dzum chen por// gang gi grags pa'i gser mdog ni// phyogs kyi glegs bu'i ngos dag la// chags pa'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams// dri med thod bzhin spyi bor long*// 'dir rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen pos brtul zhugs rang dang mnyam pa o rgyan pa zhes grags pa'i rje grub thob chen po des dpal o rgyan gyi yul nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub 'di la/ de'i dngos kyi slob ma'i zin bris bgrang yas pa las mchog tu gyur pa zla ba seng ge yin pas des glegs bam du bsgrigs pa ni/ rnam bshad go lung pa chen po gzhon nu dpal gyi zin bris/ bla ma mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer ba'i zin bris/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub kyi zin bris/ gshod lo tsa ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi zin bris bzhi tshed thub dpang po'i tshul du grangs so// gzhan lo rgyus rin chen 'phreng ba/ o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing gi lam yig /sngon 'gro/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ sdus don/ dbang bzhi'i tho yig /mdo sbyar dang bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi khrid yig dang*/ sgrub chen zab lam gser gyi snye ma gsum mkhar chu ba'i zin bris/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi khrid/ 'grel bshad yid bzhin nor bu/ rlung 'dzin stangs lnga/ bar rlung*/ 'khrul 'khor bcu bdun pa dang lnga bcu pa/ phra thig gi zur bskol lus 'chi med/ de'i 'khrul 'khor/ byang sems 'gyur med/ de'i 'khrul 'khor/ tshe sgrub gser srang pa/ 'go ba gser srang ma/ 'pho ba'i zhal gdams gnyis/ slob ma bdun la gdams pa/ tsa ri bar gnang ba'i gegs sel/ rigs bzhi'i gdams ngag phyi ma ma skal bzang gi zin bris/ gtum mo// rigs drug sa bon sreg lugs/ oṃ rgya can/ a rgya can/ hūṃ rgya (2na3)can/

'di gsum la gzigs gsum mar yang grags/ zab lam yid bzhin nor bu/ rang lus phyi nang gsang ba'i 'khrul 'khor/ dbang gi zhu lan lo rgyus/ dkyil 'khor cho ga /dbang bzhi dmar khrid/ brtag dgug sba dbyung gi yig chung*/ chu 'thung dri med rigs lnga'i bcud len/ bdud rtsi lnga phrugs/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi 'khrul 'khor/ rtsa rlung sgra gcan gyi chings/ gzhung chung rtsa 'grel/ ngo sprod kyi yig rigs gsum/ gegs sel snyan rgyud ma che ba/ bdud rtsi 'phreng ba'o gces phrug brgyad cu ma la gzhung lde mig zhal gdams gsum/ rin chen 'phreng ba/ sman dpyad ma/ grags byang zhu lan/ snyan rgyud ma chung ba/ ha dmigs stag 'then/ dbyug chos/ zhal gdams thor bu ba rnams te mdzad byang dmigs bsal med pa rnams zla seng ba'i zin bris rje nyid kyi spyan lam du bab pa 'ba' zhig go// 'dir rgya zor ba'i sgrub chen gyis dpe lnga rol pa'i rdo rje'i zin bris/ bka' bzhi pa'i bar rlung gi khrid rnams bzhugs te bar rlung phal 'di la rtsis che ste snga ma bzang*/ tsha chud pa'i bar rlung du grags pa yig sna gsum rnams so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/ chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// khar bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
